groups.label: Cost

actions.expr: 'Hinge type must be selected between Standard/Continuous'

IIF(
CONTAINS(material,'$[AZ]','$[GI]'),
CFLOAT(
OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[GI & AZ Handle Cost (per PC)]','cost')
),
IIF(CONTAINS(material,'$[AL]'),
CFLOAT(
OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[AL Handle Cost (per PC)]','cost')
),
IIF(CONTAINS(material,'$[SS304L]','$[SS316L]'),
CFLOAT(
OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[SS Handle Cost (per PC)]','cost')
),0)))
*(1+CFLOAT(
OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Accessories Wastage (AD)]','cost')
))

NUMBER(camLockQty) 
* 
IIF(
CONTAINS(material,'$[AZ]','$[GI]'),
CFLOAT(
OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[GI & AZ Cam Lock Cost (per PC)]','cost')
),
IIF(CONTAINS(material,'$[AL]'),
CFLOAT(
OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[AL Cam Lock Cost (per PC)]','cost')
),
IIF(CONTAINS(material,'$[SS304L]','$[SS316L]'),
CFLOAT(
OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[SS Cam Lock Cost (per PC)]','cost')
),0)))
*
(1+CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Accessories Wastage (AD)]','cost')))

EVALUATE(' return Math.max(input.arg1,input.arg2);', CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Min Door Fabrication Minutes]','cost')), NUMBER(doorMetalArea) * IIF( CONTAINS(material,'$[AZ]','$[GI]'), CFLOAT( OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[GI & AZ Door Fabrication Minutes (per sqm)]','cost') ), IIF(CONTAINS(material,'$[AL]'), CFLOAT( OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[AL Door Fabrication Minutes (per sqm)]','cost') ), IIF(CONTAINS(material,'$[SS304L]','$[SS316L]'), CFLOAT( OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[SS Door Fabrication Minutes (per sqm)]','cost') ),0))) )

EVALUATE(' return Math.max(input.arg1,input.arg2);', 10, NUMBER(roundFittingArea) * IIF( CONTAINS(material,'$[AZ]','$[GI]'), CFLOAT( OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[GI & AZ Fitting Fabrication Minutes (per m)]','cost') ), IIF(CONTAINS(material,'$[AL]'), CFLOAT( OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[AL Fitting Fabrication Minutes (per m)]','cost') ), IIF(CONTAINS(material,'$[SS304L]','$[SS316L]'), CFLOAT( OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[SS Fitting Fabrication Minutes (per m)]','cost') ),0))) )

CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Fixed Frame Fabrication Minutes]','cost')) + ( NUMBER(frameLength) * IIF( CONTAINS(material,'$[AZ]','$[GI]'), CFLOAT( OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[GI & AZ Frame Fabrication Minutes (per m)]','cost') ), IIF(CONTAINS(material,'$[AL]'), CFLOAT( OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[AL Frame Fabrication Minutes (per m)]','cost') ), IIF(CONTAINS(material,'$[SS304L]','$[SS316L]'), CFLOAT( OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[SS Frame Fabrication Minutes (per m)]','cost') ),0))))

IIF( (CONTAINS(doorConstruction,'$[Standard]')), 0, IIF( CONTAINS(material,'$[AZ]','$[GI]'), CFLOAT( OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[GI & AZ Door Welding Minutes (per door)]','cost') ), IIF(CONTAINS(material,'$[AL]'), CFLOAT( OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[AL Door Welding Minutes (per door)]','cost') ), IIF(CONTAINS(material,'$[SS304L]','$[SS316L]'), CFLOAT( OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[SS Door Welding Minutes (per door)]','cost') ),0))) )

IIF( (CONTAINS(frameConstruction,'$[Standard]')), 0, IIF( CONTAINS(material,'$[AZ]','$[GI]'), CFLOAT( OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[GI & AZ Frame Welding Minutes (per frame)]','cost') ), IIF(CONTAINS(material,'$[AL]'), CFLOAT( OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[AL Frame Welding Minutes (per frame)]','cost') ), IIF(CONTAINS(material,'$[SS304L]','$[SS316L]'), CFLOAT( OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[SS Frame Welding Minutes (per frame)]','cost') ),0))) )

((NUMBER(doorProcessingMinutes) + NUMBER(frameProcessingMinutes) + NUMBER(fittingsProcessingMinutes)) /60*CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Cost per Hour (AD)]','cost'))) + ((NUMBER(doorWeldingMinutes) + NUMBER(frameWeldingMinutes))/60*CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Welding Rate per Hour]','cost')))

CONCAT(
    IIF((NUMBER(doorWidthWi) > 0), CONCAT( 'W:' , NUMBER(doorWidthWi)) , ''),
    IIF((NUMBER(doorHeightHi) > 0), CONCAT( ' H:' , NUMBER(doorHeightHi)) , ''),
    IIF((NUMBER(ductDiameterDi) > 0), CONCAT( ' Duct Dia:' , NUMBER(ductDiameterDi)) , ''),
    IIF((COUNT(material) > 0), CONCAT( ' - ' ,SELECTEDVALUE(material)) , ''),
    ' ',
    SELECTEDVALUE(model),
    ' ',
    TEXT(subcategory)
)

constraints.when: EVALUATE(' var roles = input.arg1.split(","); if(roles.indexOf("OneCPQ Admin") != -1) return false; return true; ',USERINFO('roles'))
